rationale: C04 is a concrete and material drafting template: it is an earlier Venezuela financial-sanctions order with the same opening transaction formula, the same exception clause, the same anti-evasion and conspiracy provisions, the same sequence of definitions, an almost identical definition of the Government of Venezuela, and essentially identical Treasury implementation machinery. The child adapts C04's debt, equity, and securities restrictions to additional categories of Venezuelan government debt, collateral, and equity transfers. C06 is also a close textual template for the common structure, but its substantive target is digital currency rather than the debt-and-equity machinery carried forward from C04. C16 is third because it supplies the Venezuela sanctions framework and related definition, but its principal blocking-and-entry machinery is less closely matched.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All transactions related to, provision of financing for, and other dealings in the following by a United States person or within the United States are prohibited: (i) the purchase of any debt owed to the Government of Venezuela ... (iii) the sale, transfer, assignment, or pledging as collateral ... of any equity interest
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All transactions related to, provision of financing for, and other dealings in the following by a United States person or within the United States are prohibited: (i) new debt ... of Petroleos de Venezuela, S.A. (PdVSA); (ii) new debt ... or new equity, of the Government of Venezuela ... (iii) bonds issued by the Government of Venezuela
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C04's distinctive transaction formulation and Venezuela-focused debt/equity sanctions mechanism while substituting additional covered financial instruments and dealings.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted before the effective date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The prohibitions in subsections (a) and (b) of this section apply except to the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted before the effective date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim qualification clause, adjusted only to the child's subsection structure.
